title: AI Model Hub catalog
description: The document read from config/models.json. `hosts` declares shared engine processes once; `models` declares each model as data. Adding a model means adding an entry here plus, only if its engine kind is unsupported, one adapter — never a change to the router, the agent prompt, or DeepSeek Harness.

$comment.description: A note for human readers. Unknown keys anywhere in this document are ignored, so a hand-edited catalog is tolerant of stray fields.

version.description: Schema version of this document, so a future breaking change can migrate rather than guess. Currently `1`.

hosts.description: Shared processes. A host exists so that 'how do I launch this engine' is written once when several models sit behind it.

models.description: The models. Every entry must declare `host` or an inline `runtime`, but not both.

capability.description: What a caller asks for. The router filters on this and only this.

modelType.description: What the model fundamentally is. Drives operator-facing grouping and adapter defaults; the router does not filter on it.

ioType.description: An artifact kind a model can consume or produce.

adapterKind.description: How the hub talks to the model. One adapter per kind is registered in code; adding a model on an existing kind requires no code.

healthCheckKind.description: How liveness is established. `none` trusts the adapter; `tcp`/`http` probe the endpoint; `command` runs a program and accepts exit code 0.

command.description: A command plus its arguments, passed to spawn as an argv array. Never a shell string, so there is nothing to inject into.
Executable name or absolute path. A bare name must appear in the deployment's command allowlist unless `allowAnyCommand` is set.

args.description: Arguments passed verbatim. NUL bytes and line breaks are refused.

runtime.description: Where and how a model executes. `endpoint` covers 'already running somewhere'; `launch` covers 'we know how to start it'.

engine.description: Free-form engine label for operators and logs, e.g. `llama.cpp`, `ollama`, `diffusers`, `comfyui`, `blender`.

endpoint.description: Base URL of a long-lived server. Required for the `http_json` and `openai_compatible` adapters.

path.description: Request path appended to `endpoint`, e.g. `/sdapi/v1/txt2img`. Omitted means the adapter's own default.

modelPath.description: Where the weights live. Only meaningful for CLI engines that read a local checkpoint.

env.description: Extra environment variables for a launched process. Credential-shaped variables are stripped from the inherited environment regardless.

args.description: Extra arguments appended to the launch command's own arguments.

dataDir.description: Directory the engine should use for caches and outputs.

resources.description: What the model needs while resident. Routing rejects a model whose declared needs exceed the detected machine.

diskGb.description: Disk space needed for weights, in gibibytes.

requiresGpu.description: Whether a CUDA-capable GPU is mandatory rather than merely preferred. Defaults to false.

allowConcurrentInstances.description: Whether two instances may be resident at once. Defaults to false, making the model an exclusive resource.

limits.description: Model-specific size limits routing can filter on.

contextTokens.description: Maximum context window in tokens, for text models.

maxWidth.description: Maximum input image width in pixels.

maxHeight.description: Maximum input image height in pixels.

resolutions.description: Resolutions the model supports, as `WIDTHxHEIGHT` strings.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum output audio/video duration in seconds.

lifecycle.description: How to start and stop the model's process. Omitting it marks the model as external: the hub only ever talks to its endpoint and never spawns anything.

startable.description: Whether the hub may start this model. Requires `start`.

stoppable.description: Whether the hub may stop it. Requires `start` or `stop` so the hub has a process to own.

startupTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a clean start before the launch is a failure. Defaults to 120000.

shutdownTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a clean stop before a forced kill. Defaults to 15000.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Stop the process after this many idle milliseconds. Off when omitted or 0 — unloading a model the user is about to reuse is worse than holding VRAM.

awaitHealthOnStart.description: Whether a start waits for the health check to pass. Defaults to true.

health.description: How to check liveness. Defaults from the adapter kind: HTTP-based adapters get an HTTP probe, `cli` and `mock` get `none`.

path.description: Path for an `http` check. Defaults to `/`.

command.description: Command for a `command` check; subject to the launch guardrails.

timeoutMs.description: Per-attempt timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 2000.

host.description: A shared process several models sit behind.

id.description: Unique id referenced by a model's `host`.

enabled.description: Whether the host's models may be selected. Defaults to true.

model.description: One model. Only id, name, type, and capabilities are structurally required; `host` or `runtime` supplies the rest.

id.description: Unique, stable, kebab-case id. Never reused for a different model.

capabilities.description: What the model can do. This — not `type` — is what routing filters on.

inputTypes.description: Artifact kinds accepted as input. Defaults from the declared capabilities; a declared value that no capability accepts is a validation error.

outputTypes.description: Artifact kinds produced as output. Defaults from the declared capabilities.

version.description: Version of this descriptor, e.g. `1.0.0` or a model release date.

host.description: Id of the host that owns the process. Mutually exclusive with inline `runtime`.

adapterConfig.description: Free-form adapter settings. The shape is owned by the adapter, not the catalog.

enabled.description: Whether routing may select this model. Defaults to true.

priority.description: Lower is preferred when several models tie on capability. Defaults to 100.

tags.description: Deployment/environment tags, e.g. ["gpu", "production"]. Callers can require them.

notes.description: Operator notes and provenance; never interpreted by the hub.
